posts.linkedin:
Small businesses waste hours answering the same address and timing questions over the phone or chat.

A café owner may be cooking dinner when a call comes in about opening hours. A clinic receptionist might repeat the clinic’s address to several callers in one evening. A shop owner can lose track of how many times they have typed the street name on WhatsApp. These interruptions add up to lost personal time each week.

I create a fast, mobile‑first website that works on any phone and serves small businesses across India. It is a simple informational site with a responsive layout and a period of edits after launch. Packages can include up to five pages, a floating WhatsApp button linked to your number, and optional features such as an AI chatbot or a Google business profile.

The process starts when you tell me what you sell and the questions customers ask most often. I build the pages, you review them and request changes, and we repeat until the site matches your needs. You pay only after you approve the final version. There is no upfront fee or long‑term contract.

Customers can view your timings, photos, rates and location at any hour, even when you are asleep. Click‑to‑call and WhatsApp buttons let a visitor start a conversation with a single tap. Because the site loads quickly and fits a phone screen, most visitors can read the information without zooming or waiting. This can free you from repeating the same answers and give you more time for core work.

A website does not replace a person for complex or unique questions. It can answer repeat queries about address, hours and services, but a customer with a specific problem will still need to speak with you. The site also does not guarantee higher search rankings or more revenue; it simply provides a proper online place that search engines can show.

If this sounds useful, I can discuss what fits your business and answer any questions. Payment is required only after you approve the final site. Message me with the word SITE.
posts.bluesky: 11 pm: a customer asks for your address. A mobile site shows timings, map and a tap-to-call button, so you can finish dinner instead of answering the phone. DM SITE if you want to talk about one. #SmallBusinessIndia

replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I build fast, mobile-first websites for small businesses in India so customers can find your address and hours without calling you. Packages start at INR 1,499 and go up to INR 3,599, with domain setup at INR 800. To give you an exact number, I need to know: do you want customers to call you, WhatsApp you, or book directly? I can explain how it would work for you and give a fixed-price scope. Prefer a 5-minute WhatsApp chat or details here? Payment is only after you approve the work.

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out. I build websites for any small business that talks to customers - shops, cafes, clinics, gyms, salons, coaching centres. What kind of business do you run, and what do customers ask you most often?

Hi, thanks for asking. A website handles the repeat questions about address and timings, but it will not replace a personal reply when a customer has a unique or complicated question. What kind of calls are you getting most often?
